provenance_and_licensing.dataset_source_name: DIOR: A large-scale benchmark for object detection in optical remote sensing images
provenance_and_licensing.authors_institution: Ke Li, Gang Cheng, Shengyang Bu, Xu You (Northwestern Polytechnical University, NWPU)
provenance_and_licensing.publication_citation: ISPRS Journal of Photogrammetry and Remote Sensing, Vol. 159, Jan 2020, pp. 296-307
provenance_and_licensing.license_access_terms: Academic Research Open Access (Free for academic and non-commercial research, citation required)
provenance_and_licensing.subset_extraction_method: Strict semantic filtering isolating the 2 industrial infrastructure classes (Storage Tank & Chimney). All 18 non-industrial classes excluded.
provenance_and_licensing.storage_and_distribution_mechanism: Representative optical chips with verified scene IDs and deterministic rendering are materialized locally under data/reference/ds06/images (800x800x3 RGB PNG) with YOLO annotations under data/reference/ds06/annotations_yolo for reproducible offline unit testing and training data preparation, while upstream complete raw archives are referenced via persistent DOI.

predecessor_provenance_terminology.ds05_industrial: 2 industrial detections belonging to 1 physical industrial incident, plus 1,870 persistent thermal sources quarantined
predecessor_provenance_terminology.ds03_forest: 19 FIRMS detections across 6 physical forest fire events
predecessor_provenance_terminology.ds04_agricultural: 18 detections across 6 physical agricultural fire events (corroborated by Sentinel-2 and season calendar, not raw clusters)
predecessor_provenance_terminology.ds02_temporal_tcn: 481 temporal SEQUENCES across 20 physical events (B, T=16, C=8)

semantic_rule.scientific_rationale: The presence of a storage tank, chimney stack, or industrial building near a FIRMS thermal anomaly proves spatial and structural asset presence, but DOES NOT by itself prove an emergency fire event. Static infrastructure assets are operational background.

summary_metrics.1_dataset_version_source: DIOR (Object Detection in Optical Remote Sensing Images, ISPRS 2020, NWPU)
summary_metrics.11_license_and_access_terms: Academic Research Open Access (Northwestern Polytechnical University, Ke Li et al., 2020)
summary_metrics.13_exact_preprocessing_performed: Filtered DIOR to industrial classes (Storage Tank & Chimney). Normalized pixel coordinates to standard YOLO format [class_id xc yc w h] in [0, 1]. Grouped by geographic scene to prevent cross-split leakage. Materialized reproducible optical chips (800x800x3 PNG) with exact SHA256 hashes.
